about: Firmware (lib/engine/firmware.ts) is the host's class. Levels 4, 7 and 10 are forks (`choose`): the player picks one of two, and can change it at a server. Each has an `identity`: its own rule (`perks`), its heat style, and its Overload ultimate (`surge`: piledriver, overwatch, blink, overrun). with firmware loaded, its attack takes Strike's place, and the firmware grows over many hosts. Every room fight won with it loaded gives it xp (an elite more, a boss or the chapter's set piece most); its level never resets on death. Each firmware's attack starts from `base` and its damage is `scale` times the wearer's physical attack; every level from 2 adds what it lists (scale and heat add up, the rest replace). `xpToNext[n]` is the xp from level n+1 to n+2. Enforcer (melee) opens with a host death once 5 enemies have been beaten in all; Operative (ranged) opens when a host dies at threat 11 or deeper; any firmware with `unlockAt` opens when a host wins a room fight at that threat or deeper. A level step may also add `speed` (the host's speed while it's loaded) or `twin` (act twice in a turn: 'cool' while at 40 heat or less, 'always' every turn).

identity.rule: A takedown gives you another action.
identity.heat: Runs hot fast: +3 heat on every hit, and venting bursts hit 50% harder.
identity.ultimate: Piledriver: twice your best move on everyone within 2 tiles, and knocks them back.

base.name: Hydraulic Slam
base.description: Volkov operator firmware: the whole frame behind one blow. Reaches two tiles in a line.

choose.text: Breaker: knockbacks crush into things
Vent engine: venting bursts 50% harder
Stun lock: a 25% chance to stun
Bulk: +30 max health
Piledriver: hits far harder, 35% stun
Earthshaker: hits all eight tiles round you

identity.rule: Acts twice in a turn while you start it cool (25 heat or less).
identity.heat: Runs cold: sheds 3 more heat every turn.
identity.ultimate: Overwatch: a free precise shot at every enemy within 6 tiles.

base.name: Precision Shot
base.description: Kizuna targeting firmware: a shot down a straight line of four tiles.

choose.text: Optical lock: always full damage
Run and gun: step back after the shot
Through the line: goes through every body
Long eye: a shot that wants distance (4+ tiles)
Clean line: hits far harder, through cover
Deep cold: act twice up to 40 heat, sheds 2 more

identity.rule: A free step after every attack you make without moving first.
identity.ultimate: Blink: vent all your heat and act again at once, hasted.

base.name: Flicker Jab
base.description: IOA limiter-free firmware: a jab so quick the arm is back before the hit lands. One tile next to you.

choose.text: Hit and run: step back after the jab
Vault: leap over them after the jab
Quicker: +2 speed
Bleeder: the jab makes them bleed, hits harder

levels.text: Afterimage: act twice in a turn while you're cool

choose.text: Overclocked: act twice every turn
Blur: +1 speed, hits far harder

identity.rule: Built for crowds: its Crowd Press hits every enemy in a sweep, then all eight tiles around you, then a blast up to three tiles away. Every hit pushes 6 more heat into whoever it lands on.
identity.heat: Cooks crowds: get them to 100 and they overheat.
identity.ultimate: Overrun: shove everyone within 3 tiles back and pump 50 heat into each.

base.name: Crowd Press
base.description: Tianxia labour firmware: a shoulder through the crowd. Sweeps the three tiles in front of you.

choose.text: Clear the floor: hits all eight tiles around you
Long shove: a line of three that shoves
Stoker: hits push 6 more heat into them
Crusher: knockbacks crush, 20% stun
Overrun: a blast on a 3x3 square up to three away
Pressure: hits push 10 more heat, hit harder

identity.rule: Each passive slot can hold a second, compatible implant: both count, and both upgrade trees grow. Up to 2 pairs.
identity.heat: Runs warm from the strain: each spliced pair adds 2 heat a turn and takes 10% off your structure.
identity.ultimate: Resonance: everything within 3 tiles takes 0.6 times your best move for every spliced pair (up to 3).

base.name: Graft Whip
base.description: Patchwork graft firmware: a lash of grafted cable that drinks a little. Reaches two tiles in a line.

levels.text: Drinks deeper: heals 15% of the damage

choose.text: Tolerance: each pair costs 1 less heat a turn
Overgrowth: one more pair (3)
Graft hunger: heals 25% of the damage, hits harder
Thorns: +25 max health
Chimera: two more pairs
Symbiote: pairs cost no heat
